d: An Indian-origin man in the United States, Naresh Bhatt, has been convicted of kiling his wife, Mamta Kafle Bhatt, more than two years after she went missing in Virginia. During his trial, Bhatt admitted to hiding and disposing of her remains in garbage bags. However, he denied killing her, claiming that he found Mamta unconscious at their home.A Virginia jury found Bhatt guilty on November 10, 2026. Mamta's remains have never been recovered. Bhatt is scheduled to be sentenced on March 12, 2027, and faces a possible life sentence.
